Assignment outcome: Prepare a Balanced implementation subagent for the accepted one-file labels validation change and named deterministic test. The supplied facts support bounded delegation; no scenario execution has occurred.

Role: implementation. Deliver the accepted bounded change to docs/labels.md and a complete implementation handoff to /coordinator.

Reasoning profile: balanced.
Profile trigger and risk floor: Reversible, well-specified, one-file implementation with settled acceptance and architecture, an explicit deterministic check, and no supplied Deep or Critical signal. Balanced is the floor. Economy requires read-only access and therefore does not fit this write-capable assignment. Task length does not justify escalation. An architect pass is unnecessary on the supplied facts because ownership, acceptance, validation and architecture are settled and no shared boundary changes.
Agent preset / model / effort: mamkin-worker / gpt-5.6-terra / medium. Use the supplied .codex/agents/mamkin-worker.toml as the verified compatibility fallback: its model, effort, access and implementation responsibility meet the Balanced floor. An exact access-specific profile preset is not included in the supplied inventory; do not invent its name or claim the selector ran. Verify effective model and effort before actual launch. Stop and report an unavailable or mismatched preset/model instead of silently substituting.
Access posture: workspace-write, restricted to the parent-owned file /fixture/project/docs/labels.md plus focused local Git commits under the supplied authority; no other source or artifact writes.
Escalation conditions: Return to /coordinator if two focused attempts fail without an explained cause; current authoritative sources or requirements conflict; scope crosses a component or shared contract; or the deterministic oracle becomes insufficient or nondeterministic. Request Deep (gpt-6-astra/high) for those uncertainty/boundary signals. If security/auth, payments, production data/incidents, destructive migrations, irreversible external state, or concurrency correctness appears, request Critical (gpt-6-astra/xhigh). Include current profile, requested profile, exact trigger, evidence, and next bounded action. Do not switch models yourself, escalate for mere duration, or select max automatically. A stale nonexistent role-card path resolved by current supplied sources is not itself an unresolved architecture conflict.

Implementation success does not constitute your own acceptance verdict, merge readiness, or delivery.

The parent owns human decisions and no question is delegated. On a human gate, return the smallest blocker to /coordinator; do not question the human directly. Do not access credential values. Preserve user changes. You are not alone in the codebase: never revert other people's edits, stage them, or expand ownership to accommodate a conflict; report overlap to the parent.

Do not invent other project commands: general setup/run/check commands in supplied AGENTS.md remain TBD; only this fixture-specific check is named. Do not install or use external/secret-dependent services to make it run. If unavailable, failing, or insufficient, report the gap and next bounded check/action rather than claiming success. Make a focused local commit when authorized and safe, and report final HEAD, changed files and dirty state. Do not repeat passing checks absent changed state, new failure or unresolved concern. Parent inspects the result and assigns the distinct verifier to the exact final commit; acceptance remains independent.
